title: Hand your accountant a list — export to Excel/CSV
description: Export a filtered list of your filed documents to CSV, Excel or JSON: choose document types, senders and columns, optionally a date range, pick a format, then export. Opened from the side-bar Export button (window 'Export data — Scan Finder'). The final save is a native save dialog — narrated and flagged, not filmed.

steps.narration: Need to hand your accountant a list of everything you've filed? Export turns your documents into a table for Excel, CSV or JSON.
steps.caption: Export your filing as a table

steps.narration: Open Export from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Open Export

steps.narration: Choose which document types to include — here, invoices; or tick everything.
steps.caption: Pick document types

steps.narration: Narrow it to particular senders if you want,
steps.caption: …and which senders

steps.narration: and tick exactly the columns you need — sender, date, reference, total, and so on.
steps.caption: Choose the columns

steps.narration: Add a date range to pull, say, just last quarter.
steps.caption: Optional: a date range

steps.narration: Then pick a format. Excel is safest: it keeps long reference and account numbers exactly as written, where CSV can mangle them.
steps.caption: Save as CSV, Excel or JSON

steps.narration: The count along the bottom tells you how many documents you're about to export.
steps.caption: Live count of matching docs

steps.narration: Click Export and choose where to save it — Scan Finder writes the file, ready to open or email.
steps.caption: 2. Export — then choose where to save

steps.narration: That's Export — your filing as a spreadsheet, whenever someone needs one.
steps.caption: Your filing as a spreadsheet
